t: This is The George Inn, a public house on Borough High Street in Southwark. It was established in the medieval period, and it's the only surviving galleried London coaching inn. Look for the galleries running along the upper floors. The inn stands about 250 metres from the south side of the Thames, near London Bridge. It's owned and leased by the National Trust. Leslie C. Staples is recorded as one of its owners, though the material I have says little more about him than that.
